_sorting._comment: Picture sorter (ADR-0009): a local CLIP model matches each reference picture against these prompts and the topics' `prompts`. Used only to sort reference pictures, never to grade or critique drawings. A topic is the mean of its prompts. Style: reject if the category's allowed styles get less than minStyle. Topic: compared with every topic of every category in the same group; re-file if the best beats the own topic by margin and has at least minBest, reject if the own topic has less than rejectBelow, otherwise keep. Categories not listed here (fundamentals) are not checked.

photo: a high quality photo of a real thing
